en: A monochrome (black-and-white) photograph of a narrow European street with tall, attached townhouses. The central building has a steep stepped or triangular gable with several small, irregular window openings suggesting a medieval or Gothic merchant house. Adjacent houses have simpler façades with rectangular windows and arched doorways. A few people stand or walk along the empty street. The rooflines are steep and tiled, and in the distance a larger roof or spire is partially visible. There is no printed caption on the front; only a small handwritten number appears near the top edge.
